# AI Usage Policy

This policy applies to all repositories of the Example organisation.

## Good use of AI

- Asking an AI to explain unfamiliar code.
- Using AI to help you phrase an issue, a PR description, or a reply to review feedback, as long as you read and stand behind it.

## Disallowed use of AI

- Pasting AI output you have not read.
- Letting an agent answer review feedback on its own, without you approving each reply.
- Submitting AI-generated code without testing it.

## Your responsibility

- You must run the tests locally before opening a PR.
- Declare AI usage with the checkbox in the pull request template. Crediting
  your tool with a `Co-authored-by` trailer is up to you; what we require is
  your own DCO sign-off.
